narration.text: Hi, I'm Claudia! Let's make a tiny explainer. One idea, a clear example, and absolutely no fifty-slide detour.

scenes.title: Give the idea somewhere to land

narration.text: Start with the point. Show what it means. Then give your viewer one useful next step. See? We're already getting somewhere.
Now try your own story. Review the words, watch the result, and keep the version you like. Tiny movie, useful idea.
